# Never-loaded gap between sec5 and sec6

534 KiB of the image outside every section load, usable once sec5 has loaded; fenykl's dev monitor runs test programs here.

**Category:** free space · **Address:** `0x60f8a800` to `0x61010000` (runtime cached) · <span class="pill pill-released">Camera-confirmed</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [E-M10 Mark II firmware 1.4, build 1400](../firmware/em10-ii-1400.md) · **Cameras:** [Olympus OM-D E-M10 Mark II](../cameras/em10-ii.md)

Free RAM, not free file space. fenykl's dev monitor claims the whole range for 16 test-program slots of 32 KiB and its job buffer, so another user on the same camera must coordinate with it.

## Observations

- **Static analysis** ([fenykl](../projects/fenykl.md)): Described as a never-loaded hole, valid once section 5 is loaded and unused by the firmware. Source: [fenykl E-M10 Mark II target description](../sources/fenykl.target.md).
- **Physical camera** ([fenykl](../projects/fenykl.md)): A dev-monitor test program ran from this range on the maintainer's camera (2026-11-17). Source: [fenykl plugin SDK](../sources/fenykl.sdk.md).
